test_title: PYST 27: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Hesitate
solution: The correct answer is: **Dither**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Hesitate **means to pause or hold back in uncertainty or reluctance. (अनिश्चितता या अनिच्छा में रुकना) • **Example**: *She didn't hesitate to express her opinions during the meeting.* • Marked option **Dither **means to be indecisive or hesitant. (अनिर्णय या झिझक होना) • **Example**: *Faced with conflicting advice, she began to dither about which career path to choose.* Therefore, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Haste **means to do something quickly without much thought or care. (बिना अधिक सोचे-समझे या परवाह किए शीघ्रता से कुछ करना) • **Stumble **means to trip or lose balance while walking or running. (चलते या दौड़ते समय लड़खड़ाना या संतुलन खोना) • **Hassle **means to cause trouble or inconvenience. (परेशानी या असुविधा पैदा करना) 37:T508,The correct answer is: "**It is raining cats and dogs**."
